definition: Raises equipment, floors, foundations or structures above identified flood levels.
Provides drainage that protects identifiable infrastructure against flooding or water accumulation. Standalone drainage investment without a protected asset is insufficient.
Uses barriers, walls, sealing or waterproof enclosures to protect facilities or equipment against floodwater. Cable protection has its own type.
Protects cables against identified hazards through armouring, waterproof ducts, conduits or protective trench design. Choosing burial alone is climate_informed_siting.
Strengthens structures, towers or overhead lines against identified wind or storm hazards.
Protects equipment or structures against extreme heat through tolerant components, shading or thermal design. Energy-efficient cooling alone is insufficient.
Reinforces structures, foundations or slopes against earthquake, landslide or erosion hazards.

Protects equipment against identified rain, dust, humidity or corrosion hazards through enclosures, coatings or materials. Routine weather resistance without a hazard-protection function is insufficient.
